{{Top|leg}}
A '''spaceboat''' was an extremely light spacecraft, smaller than even a [[lighter]] and generally not [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was able to shoot one down using only a [[Kell Mark II heavy assault rifle]]. At least some models were armed.
